title: Mestrado em Informática
institution: Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio), Departamento de Informática
about: PUC-Rio's Department of Informatics is selecting master's students in Informática for the first semester of 2027. The university's central graduate table lists 2 December 2026 as the master's application deadline; applications are made online.
requirements: Selection for programmes starting in 2027.1; master's application deadline 02/12/2026
Previous DI calls required a degree, transcripts, CV and at least two reference letters (check the 2027.1 edital)

upskill.name: the course catalog
why: No course scored a genuine match: the stated requirements ("a degree, transcripts, CV and at least two reference letters") are documents, not skills covered by any course objective; shortlist hits came only from the stem "comput" in "Computer Vision", so the post links to the Academy catalog, not a specific course.
